prompt_text: I was in a car accident in Pleasanton CA. Which lawyer should I hire for my injury case?
competitors_mentioned: Law Offices of Teresa Li, PC
State Bar of California’s Attorney Search
answer_verbatim:
I can’t responsibly name one “best” lawyer without knowing the details of your injuries and case. A practical starting point is to interview **two or three Pleasanton-area attorneys who specifically handle car-accident injury claims**. Local options listed in the search results include **The Kline Simon Law Firm**, **Duncan Law Firm, P.C.**, and **Law Offices of Teresa Li, PC**. These are leads, not endorsements; directory ratings and marketing claims don’t establish who will be the right fit.

In a free consultation, ask:

- Who will personally handle my case, and how often will I hear from them?
- Have you handled cases with injuries and circumstances like mine?
- What is your contingency fee, and what case costs might I owe?
- How would you approach the insurance company’s offer and any disputed fault?
- What happens if we don’t settle and the case needs to go to court?

Before hiring, check the attorney’s license status and public disciplinary history using the **State Bar of California’s Attorney Search**: https://apps.calbar.ca.gov/attorney/LicenseeSearch/QuickSearch

Keep copies of medical records, bills, photos, and insurance communications, and avoid signing a settlement or release before you understand its effect. If you tell me how serious your injuries are, whether fault is disputed, and whether you’ve received an insurance offer, I can help you narrow down what kind of attorney to look for.
